tips.coach: any chat · strong model, allow web search
about: The agent researches and writes the plan as small, verifiable steps. You read the plan before anything is built.
Any chat: the step reads everything it needs from the files. Strong model with web search: the plan checks libraries, versions and APIs against current facts.
Choose the chat and the model in your AI assistant before you paste.
Settings (gear in the Specs view): Show Step Tips hides these tips; Model Hints names your models; Assistant opens your AI assistant's chat with the prompt.
